wisdom: One does not simply walk into Lidl without a list. And yet, here we are.
Not all who wander are lost. Some have been circling the dairy aisle for twenty minutes.
The road goes ever on and on. Much like the grocery bill.
A wizard is never late. Dinner, on the other hand, is a different story.
You have my sword. And my bow. And my slightly damp reusable shopping bag.
The fellowship stands united. Except on the matter of how much cheese is enough.
There is no greater darkness than opening the fridge for the fifth time and finding nothing new.
Even the smallest snack can change the course of history. Particularly at midnight.
Second breakfast is not a luxury. It is a fundamental right.
Great adventures begin with a single step. Ours began because someone ate the last biscuit.
A full cart is a heavy burden. A full receipt is heavier still.
Some treasures are gold. Others have a yellow discount sticker.
The journey of a thousand aisles begins with forgetting why you came.
The wise plan their purchases. We have chosen a more adventurous approach.
Courage is knowing the price of olive oil and putting it in the cart anyway.
The pantry remembers nothing. That's rather the problem.
The council has spoken. Unfortunately, the council was hungry at the time.
Great adventures require great provisions. And a loyalty card nobody can find.
The road to dinner is paved with forgotten ingredients and increasingly desperate substitutions.
One list. Two adventurers. Three entirely unnecessary purchases.
A great evil stirs in the kitchen. It is the smell of something forgotten in the fridge.
There are older and fouler things than orcs in the depths of the vegetable drawer.
The fate of dinner hangs by a thread. That thread is a single egg.
Much that once was is lost. Including the receipt.
The fellowship was formed to defeat hunger. Hunger remains undefeated.
All we have to decide is what to do with the groceries we've been given. Preferably before they expire.
The greatest test of courage is entering a supermarket while hungry.
A wise adventurer never trusts a shopping cart with one suspicious wheel.
The ancient prophecies spoke of a great feast. They neglected to mention the dishes.
A true hero knows when to retreat. Especially from the self-checkout machine.
itemAdded: Another burden for the fellowship. The bags were already full.
The council has deemed this essential. The council offers no explanation.
And so the quest grows. As does the financial concern.
A noble addition. We shall pretend it was planned.
The list grows. Somewhere, a coin purse weeps.
The fellowship accepts this burden. Reluctantly.
Another item. The wagon makes a concerning noise.
An excellent choice, according to absolutely no one consulted.
The pantry demands tribute. Again. Greedy little cupboard.
One more step toward bankruptcy. But a delicious one.
The scribes have recorded your wishes. Their eyebrows are raised.
Another treasure to seek. The shopkeeper must think us obsessed.
The quest was almost manageable. You have corrected this.
The council approves. The treasury has filed a complaint.
And another! At this rate, we shall need a second donkey.
The list welcomes its newest victim.
A bold decision. Made with absolutely no supporting evidence.
The kingdom shall acquire it. Whether the kingdom needs it is another matter.
The royal shopping expedition has been extended. Again.
Somewhere, a cashier senses a disturbance.
itemPurchased: A small victory for the realm. Very small. Almost embarrassing.
Another quest fulfilled. The bards remain unimpressed.
The fellowship grows stronger. The wallet grows weaker.
One step closer to second breakfast. Or first dinner.
The provisions are secured. Guard them with your life. Or a shopping bag.
A glorious triumph! Over an object sitting on a shelf.
The realm shall not go hungry tonight. Probably.
Another burden lifted. Now physically carried.
The pantry rejoices. The fridge remains suspiciously quiet.
The deed is done. The receipt shall bear witness.
One fewer obstacle between us and dinner. Only seventeen remain.
A victory worthy of a very short song.
The bards shall sing of this day. Quietly, so as not to disturb the other shoppers.
Against all odds, you found it exactly where it was supposed to be.
The prophecy has been fulfilled. Nobody is particularly surprised.
The item has been captured. Do not let it escape at checkout.
A heroic deed. The cashier has yet to notice.
The council applauds. One person clapped.
Another treasure claimed! Please remember to pay for it.
The fellowship advances. The trolley continues pulling to the left.
itemEdited: The ancient records have been amended. The scribes are exhausted.
The council has reconsidered. The council does this a lot.
A minor correction to the prophecy. The oracle was having an off day.
History has been rewritten. The historians are furious.
The scribes have been notified. One has resigned.
Even the wisest make grocery mistakes. Some of us make them professionally.
The prophecy was slightly inaccurate. By approximately three kilograms.
The fellowship has changed its mind. A shocking development.
The sacred texts required adjustments. Apparently, nobody proofread them.
A new decree has replaced the old. Please destroy all previous scrolls.
The royal records have been updated. The ink was barely dry.
A correction! The council insists this was always the plan.
The historians will have a difficult time explaining this one.
The ancient scroll has been edited. Ancient is a relative term.
The prophecy now says something else. Convenient.
The council denies ever requesting the original quantity.
itemDeleted: And so it was banished from the realm. Its crimes remain classified.
This item shall trouble us no more. Unless someone adds it again.
The council has spoken. Begone, unnecessary provision!
A sacrifice had to be made. The budget demanded blood. Figuratively.
Its journey ends here. It barely had time to unpack.
We shall speak of this no more. Especially at dinner.
Gone, but probably back on the list by Thursday.
The prophecy has been cancelled due to insufficient enthusiasm.
It was never truly needed. That's our official story.
Into the void it goes. The void is getting rather crowded.
A tragic end to a very short and entirely pointless adventure.
The item has been exiled. No forwarding address was provided.
The scribes have erased all evidence. You saw nothing.
The kingdom has decided it can live without this. Brave words.
Removed from the sacred list. The pantry breathes a sigh of relief.
Another casualty of the Great Budget Council.
The item has fallen. We shall remember it for approximately four seconds.
The fellowship denies all knowledge of this purchase.
Banished! The council was unusually enthusiastic about that.
And just like that, an entire quest was abandoned.
itemUnchecked: The quest continues. Someone celebrated too early.
Someone has undone our hard work. The council demands names.
The victory was premature. Please return the tiny victory banner.
Back to the battlefield. The item has apparently escaped.
The council demands a recount. And possibly a snack.
A most unfortunate turn of events. The bards must rewrite the song.
The fellowship must try again. Morale is at an all-time medium.
It seems our work here is not done. How deeply inconvenient.
The treasure has vanished! Check under the shopping bags.
A false victory! The historians are correcting their notes.
The item has returned from exile. Nobody invited it.
The quest has reopened. The paperwork is tremendous.
The prophecy remains unfulfilled. The oracle is getting impatient.
We were so close to greatness. Well, reasonably close.
The council regrets to announce that we are, in fact, not finished.
firstItemAdded: And so the quest begins. May the wallet forgive us.
Every great adventure begins with a single item. Usually followed by forty more.
The fellowship has received its first mission. Nobody volunteered.
A humble beginning to an unnecessarily expensive expedition.
The first decree has been issued. The scribes look nervous.
Our journey begins. May the discounts be plentiful and the queues merciful.
A quest is born! The kingdom has approximately no idea what comes next.
One item. One dream. Several opportunities for disaster.
The council has assembled. This could have been an email.
The first provision has been requested. The treasury is already concerned.
A new adventure begins. Please bring the reusable bags this time.
The fellowship sets forth! Once somebody finds their keys.

shoppingCompleted.title: The fellowship has prevailed!
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: Until someone remembers the one thing we actually came for.

shoppingCompleted.title: The quest is complete.
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: The pantry shall feast tonight. The wallet shall not.

shoppingCompleted.title: You bow to no one.
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: Except perhaps the cashier, who has seen things.

shoppingCompleted.title: Victory at last!
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: May your bags be strong, your eggs unbroken, and your receipt merciful.

shoppingCompleted.title: All provisions gathered.
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: Now comes the true challenge: carrying everything in one trip.

shoppingCompleted.title: A glorious victory!
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: The coin purse gave its life so that dinner might live.

shoppingCompleted.title: The fellowship triumphs!
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: Songs shall be sung. Receipts shall be quietly hidden.

shoppingCompleted.title: The quest is over!
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: The bards are composing a ballad. It is mostly about cheese.

shoppingCompleted.title: The kingdom rejoices!
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: Nobody tell the kingdom how much we spent.

shoppingCompleted.title: A legendary achievement!
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: Historians agree this was definitely a shopping trip.

shoppingCompleted.title: The final item has fallen!
shoppingCompleted.subtitle: We came. We saw. We forgot the reusable bags.

emptyList: A suspicious peace has settled over the pantry. Nobody trusts it.
The quest log is empty. The fridge tells a different story.
Nothing to acquire. The council finds this deeply suspicious.
The fellowship rests. The fellowship has clearly forgotten something.
No quests remain. Enjoy these seventeen seconds of peace.
The shelves are full. This claim has not been independently verified.
All is quiet in the realm. Far too quiet. Check the milk.
There is nothing on the list. We have almost certainly made a mistake.
The council has no demands. Someone check if the council is awake.
A rare moment of domestic harmony. Historians are baffled.
The scribes await your next questionable decision. They have cleared their schedules.
An empty list? The oracle suspects foul play.
The pantry stands silent. It knows what it did.
No provisions requested. A bold strategy for a household that eats.
The realm appears fully supplied. We give it until breakfast.
Not a single item. Has someone been shopping in secret?
The quest log is empty. This is either excellent planning or complete negligence.
The council has declared the pantry sufficient. The pantry was not consulted.
clearPurchased: History shall remember none of this. Especially the receipt.
The records have been cleansed. The scribes have conveniently forgotten everything.
The completed quests fade into legend. And the recycling bin.
The scribes have cleared the archives. Please do not ask them to retrieve anything.
A fresh chapter begins. The treasury begs for a day off.
Yesterday's victories are today's forgotten receipts.
The great shopping expedition has been erased from history. The bank statement disagrees.
The council has ordered the archives burned. Metaphorically, of course.
The deeds are forgotten. The groceries remain. Hopefully.
The scribes have wiped the slate clean. Their hands are covered in ink.
All evidence of our heroic shopping has vanished. Except the empty wallet.
A new scroll awaits. The old one was becoming embarrassingly long.
